stories.title: CAQM to govts: Cut pollution load by 15-20%, name officers
stories.summary: Commission for Air Quality Management emphasizes the need for a 15% pollution reduction in the National Capital Region. The reduction target will increase to 20% by 2027, ensuring better air quality. District-level action plans are required from Delhi, Haryana, UP, and Rajasthan.
